snippet.title: The Siege and the Sandfox | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
https://siegeandsandfox.com/
Venture through a parkour-platforming stealthvania set in a kingdom under siege. Betrayed by your Queen, so that she may hide her regicide, you must now take on the role of the Sandfox and begin your journey up to the palace. Save the kingdom from the Queen’s evil plot, reap revenge, and reclaim your honour.

Sneak, slink, and scale your way through a majestic palace and crumbling prisons. Unravel the truth buried beneath the kingdom—and rise from the depths to save it.

The Queen betrayed you. Now, it’s your turn.

Begin your journey in The Siege and the Sandfox on May 20th 2025

Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/653060/The_Siege_and_the_Sandfox/
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-siege-and-the-sandfox
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/the_siege_and_the_sandfox
Humble: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/the-siege-and-the-sandfox

Follow our socials and be the first to know the latest on The Siege and the Sandfox:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/siegeandsandfox/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/siegefox
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/siegeandsandfox/
